args.description: A single brown and white dairy COW standing side-on grazing in a field, seen from above at a steep angle. Heavy rounded body, dark head lowered to the grass, short legs, dark outline. Simple and chunky enough to read clearly at small size with several in a pasture. Just the animal, nothing else.

A small wooden mine cart on iron wheels, heaped with dark grey iron ore rock, seen from above at a steep angle. Rough plank sides, iron banding, a couple of loose ore lumps spilled beside it. Simple and chunky enough to read at small size. Just the cart, no rails, no ground.
